title: Amyl and The Sniffers · U Should Not Be Doing That
description: A neon storefront, an empty swimming pool, red bar lights and a green-lit runway frame a dance-off.

performance.lyrics: Good morning, Ah Can you shake Dr. Skin? I was struggling to tell you where I have been cuz I've been running around making national self know how you feel about that it's on me once when I showed you that but my best to get it on not everybody makes it out I love when they Young, I was a Tokyo! Showin' up a crack and you told me that I should not be doing that, hey I was in LA shaking my shit while you were down in Melbourne saying fuck that bitch You're in New York getting shit on and they were down in Novacite and you should not be doing that! Ah I'm in my head, doing the work, putting on me shoes and me socks, cuz I gotta get out of here, another person sayin' I'm not doin' it right Another person tryna give me some kind of eternal fight But I'm workin on my words, I'm workin on my work I'm workin on who I am I'm working on what is wrong, what is right, and where I am! And all my worth, I love the worst, you taught me what I was! I cannot do this anymore, I gotta hit the barstool. I was a Tokyo Poppin shit off while you went down and see you trying to get just off I was a London being the Queen and you written my head saying you should not be doing that I know my Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah Ah I was a gnome, working on my steers, while you whipped down your tat and sang in flash, there is tears I don't gotta go, showing off my flaps While you are up and busy trying to show me I can't do it like that
